name: Web basics
description: HTML, CSS and accessible JavaScript — the first stop for most newcomers. Use when the issue touches a page, a component or a stylesheet.
author: ContribMatch community

vocabulary.pull request: A change you propose to a project, with a description of what changed and why.
vocabulary.issue: A task someone wrote down for the project.
vocabulary.accessibility: Making the interface usable with a keyboard and a screen reader, not just with a mouse.

html: Say which element changes and what it should contain afterwards.
Keep the heading order of the page intact.
css: Name the token or variable you would change, not just the visual result.
Check the change in both light and dark themes if the project has both.
javascript: Name the function or module you would change and what the new behaviour should be.
Mention how you would test it: a unit test, or a manual step in the browser console.
accessibility: State the keyboard behaviour you are adding, and the focus order you expect.
Name the accessibility rule you are following if the project references one.
